integrity: The source metric definition and pointwise agreement formula were checked against the primary preprint. The all-parameter counting argument was reconstructed independently, and the packaged verifier compares the formula with direct projective enumeration over prime fields and over GF(4).
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives exact finite shell and ball counts and the vertex-orbit partition, but not an internal presentation of the full isometry group or new asymptotic coding bounds. Exhaustive replay covers small fields and dimensions; the general result rests on the stated counting proof.
title: Exact distance shells and isometry orbits for the Hamming-angle metric
